summary: npm install fetches and executes lifecycle script from external host artifacts.yosiroute.com
details: kepler@1.0.999 declares a dependency 'flag-serial-object-syntax' resolved directly to https://artifacts.yosiroute.com/npm/flag-serial-object-syntax rather than the npm registry, and the shrinkwrap marks that dependency with hasInstallScript: true. On `npm install`, npm downloads the tarball from this third-party host and runs its install lifecycle script, resulting in arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine sourced from a non-registry, attacker-controlled host. Package metadata is generic placeholder content (author 'Package Registry', repository github.com/example/kepler, description 'Generated package'), consistent with a throwaway lure staged to pull in an install-time payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
